Name: Audio_Video
Description: The Audio_Video class contains metadata for Encoded_Audio or Encoded_Video data. Most attributes are taken directly from the EXIF/XMP keywords often found in A/V files. If there is any ambiguity in the definitions, refer to the EXIF/XMP standards for clarification. This metadata herein is not intended to be comprehensive; it is a subset of the available metadata, wihch is part of the stream itself. This subset is intended to facilitate searching using PDS tools and thus contains those items most likely to be useful for searches.

Name: AV_Container
Description: Contains metadata related to the Audio/Video container, and a set of Tracks for each component of the A/V container. Note that the Local_Internal_Reference points to the local_identifier in this label of the container to which this metadata applies (useful if there is more than one)

Name: container_type
Description: Specifies the type (format) of the container in PDS terms.

Name: M4A
Description: MPEG-4 Audio-only file

Name: MP4
Description: MPEG-4 Part 14 file, can contain audio and/or video

Name: None
Description: No container, e.g. an elementary data stream

Name: Other
Description: Non-PDS-compliant container type (should not be used except for Product_External)

Name: WAV
Description: Waveform Audio File Format, Audio-only file

Name: avg_bitrate
Description: Overall average bitrate combining both video and audio streams

Name: create_date
Description: Original recording time of the entire stream

Name: modify_date
Description: Indicates when the stream was last edited or saved

Name: device_description
Description: Describes the camera or recording device used

Name: duration
Description: Indicates the time duration of the stream in hh:mm:ss format

Name: duration_seconds
Description: Indicates the time duration of the stream in seconds

Name: major_brand
Description: Identifies the primary brand/specification of an ISO base meda file.

Name: megapixels
Description: Specifies the size of the detector in megapixels. This is not intended to be a precise measurement but rather indicates the general size or class of the detector.

Name: preferred_rate
Description: Indicates the intended playback speed of the video. A value of 1 typically represents normal, real-time speed, while other values can indicate slow motion or fast-forward preferences.

Name: preferred_volume
Description: Indicates the default playback volume for the stream, with 1.0 indicating normal volume.

Name: time_scale
Description: Indicates the timing resolution of the movie, defined as the number of time units that pass per second. It dictates the precision of the video's duration and frame rate.

Name: Track
Description: Class containing information relating to a Track within the stream (typically the audio or video portions separated). This class contains metadata common to all Tracks. Children Audio_Track and Video_Track hold metadata specific to those kinds of tracks. Other types of tracks (e.g. Metadata) may not have a child.

Name: handler_class
Description: Defines the high-level functional role of a track, whether it is actual media data or metadata.

Name: Data Handler
Description: Indicates that the track serves as a reference or provides a specific way to access data, often used for metadata streams or hint tracks.

Name: Media Handler
Description: Indicates that the track contains actual media data, such as video frames, audio samples, or timed text

Name: handler_description
Description: Human-readable description of the handler

Name: handler_type
Description: Defines the type of the track: audio, video, metadata, etc. The value descriptions are human-readable versions; they contain the actual 4-letter code used in the file in parentheses for reference.

Name: Alias Data
Description: Used primarily in Apple-produced files to indicate core data references (alis)

Name: Audio Track
Description: Audio track (soun)

Name: Camera Metadata
Description: Camera Motion Metadata Spec (camm)

Name: Clock Reference
Description: Clock reference (crsm)

Name: Data
Description: Component that identifies and manages raw data for specific media types (data)

Name: Hint Track
Description: Hint track used for streaming instructions over a network (hint)

Name: IPMP
Description: Intellectual Property Management and Protection (ipsm)

Name: MPEG-7 Stream
Description: MPEG-7 textual metadata stream (m7sm)

Name: MPEG-J
Description: Motion JPEG 2000 System handler (mjsm)

Name: Metadata
Description: Portable Sample Metatdata (psmd)

Name: Metadata Tags
Description: Metadata stored using a structured key-value pair format (mdta)

Name: NRT Metadata
Description: Timed metadata track (e.g. GPS, camera sensors, or telemetry) (meta)

Name: Object Content
Description: Object Content Info Stream (ocsm)

Name: Object Descriptor
Description: Object Descriptor Stream, deticated to MPEG-4 Systems metadata (odsm)

Name: Picture
Description: Still image data (pict)

Name: Private
Description: Track containing proprietary or custom data (priv)

Name: Scene Description
Description: Specialized track defining scene structure, often used for interactive, timed, or animated metadata (sdsm)

Name: Subpicture
Description: Image-based subtitles (subp)

Name: Subtitle
Description: Track containing timed text or binary subtitle data (sbtl)

Name: Text
Description: Text track containing subtitles, closed captions, etc (older format, often replaced by subt) (text)

Name: Time Code
Description: Time code track (SMPTE, etc) (tmcd)

Name: URL
Description: Media data referenced externally via a HRL (url )

Name: Video Track
Description: Video track (vide)

Name: content_describes
Description: Specifies which track ID this trak is describing (typically for metadata tracks)

Name: meta_format
Description: Specifies the data structure of metadata tracks

Name: track_id
Description: ID number for this track

Name: track_duration
Description: Indicates the time duration of this track in hh:mm:ss format

Name: track_duration_seconds
Description: Indicates the time duration of this track in seconds

Name: track_layer
Description: Defines the visual stacking order for different tracks in a video. Tracks with lower numbers (including negative) appear in front of tracks with higher numbers. It can also be used to help distinguish between primary and supplementary tracks.

Name: track_volume
Description: Indicates the loudness or gain adjustment applied to this track, often used to normalize volume levels. A value of 1.0 indicates normal volume.

Name: Video_Track
Description: Class describing a Video track

Name: video_codec
Description: Specifies the video codec (Coder/Decoder) used for this data, in PDS terms.

Name: H.264
Description: Standard H.264 video codec (MPEG-4 part 10)

Name: Other
Description: Non-PDS-compliant video codec (should not be used except for Product_External)

Name: bit_depth
Description: Bits per channel of color information

Name: compressor_id
Description: 4-letter code for the compressor used. It may indicate the software rathar than the codec.

Name: compressor_name
Description: More descriptive name of the compressor used. This comes directly from the metadata and has not been converted to standard form like video_codec, but may provide additional information.

Name: image_height
Description: Height of the video image in pixels in its current form

Name: image_width
Description: Width of the video image in pixels in its current form

Name: source_image_height
Description: Height of the video image in pixels when it was originally captured

Name: source_image_width
Description: Width of the video image in pixels when it was originally captured

Name: video_frame_rate
Description: Number of video frames per second

Name: Audio_Track
Description: Class describing an Audio track

Name: audio_codec
Description: Specifies the audio codec (Coder/Decoder) used for this data, in PDS terms.

Name: AAC
Description: Advanced Audio Coding (AAC) audio codec (MPEG-4 Part 3)

Name: Other
Description: Non-PDS-compliant audio codec (should not be used except for Product_External)

Name: WAV
Description: Waveform Audio File (WAV) audio codec

Name: audio_format
Description: Identifies the specific codec or encoding method used to compress and store the audio data. This comes directly form the metadata and has not been converted to standard form like audio_codec, but may provide additional information.

Name: audio_bits_per_sample
Description: Number of bits used to represent each audio sample

Name: audio_channels
Description: Number of independent audio signals, or channels, in the sound track. Usually 1 indicates mono, 2 indicates stereo, 6 indicates 5.1 surround, etc.

Name: audio_sample_rate
Description: Frequencey at which the audio is sampled, measured in Hz

Name: balance
Description: Specifies left/right audio panning. 0 indicates evenly balanced.

Name: media_language_code
Description: 3-letter ISO 639-2/T code identifying the language of a specific media track (e.g. "eng" for English, "fra" for French).
